# Vendored Assets

This directory contains vendored, minified JavaScript dependencies used by `agy-usage` to render self-contained HTML dashboards without external network calls (resolving SEC-03).

## Packages

### 1. Chart.js
- **Package**: `chart.js`
- **Version**: `4.5.1`
- **Source**: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.5.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js`
- **License**: MIT (`LICENSE-chartjs`)
- **SHA-256**: `48444a82d4edcb5bec0f1965faacdde18d9c17db3063d042abada2f705c9f54a`

### 2. chartjs-adapter-date-fns
- **Package**: `chartjs-adapter-date-fns`
- **Version**: `3.0.0`
- **Source**: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chartjs-adapter-date-fns@3.0.0/dist/chartjs-adapter-date-fns.bundle.min.js`
- **License**: MIT (`LICENSE-chartjs-adapter-date-fns`)
- **SHA-256**: `ea7ab30d26c38dcf1f2d26bb43e73a94537b58f1906f55e1a546dd09321b5615`
